items.title: Complete real-input scale-explicit reference feasibility
items.scope: Exactly one 12-case prepare and one 24-opinion resolution from two accepted F9 artifacts; no DWD/search/holdout access.
acceptance: Real source identity, immutable packets, raw opinions and independent reconstruction are bound
Coverage and collection feasibility are distinct from independent semantic qualification

items.title: Freeze source, selection, review provenance and stop rules
items.scope: Freeze date-only 4-per-security selection and same-origin simulated roles before new case review.
acceptance: Twelve cases, twenty-four opinions, no replacements or result-dependent selection

items.title: Implement and release the bounded two-phase Worker route
items.scope: Reuse reference protocol, bind retained source membership and dynamic opinion input, test recovery and tampering.
acceptance: Full checks and focused gates pass before runtime

items.title: Execute fixed real-input reference collection and resolution
items.scope: Prepare exact packets, perform actual self-simulated case reviews, seal raw opinions once.
acceptance: Two exact terminal receipts and complete immutable evidence; no automated reviewer judgements

items.title: Review collection feasibility and close without candidate promotion
items.scope: Separate collection, finite descriptive coverage and absent independent semantic validation.
acceptance: Retain all disagreements and insufficiency, forbid automatic supplement or search
